verdict.rationale: The repo maintains a detailed RELEASE-NOTES.md documenting specific behavioral and skill changes release-by-release (worktree safety fixes, sdd-workspace scoping, review-fix loop restructuring, batching behavior, new harness support like Devin/Hermes), giving developers concrete visibility into what changed before updating. Missing for 10: independent/community corroboration that users actually consult this changelog pre-update, and no explicit versioning/release-tagging scheme is shown alongside the notes.
